## About this space

Our state-of-the-art cinema is available to hire on an hourly basis, either as a stand-alone screening room or as a full venue hire. Our adjoined café and bar is fully licensed and offers a convivial atmosphere for drinks receptions or informal post-screening discussion.

The 40-seat cinema is fully equipped with a 2K NEC D-cinema, 2 x Kinoton FP30-D 35mm and EX 6000 16mm projectors and Dolby 5.1 surround.

Located in the heart of Shoreditch, Close-Up is the ideal venue for all your screening needs, whether you wish to host a press screening, corporate event, presentation, conference, cast and crew preview, Christmas or birthday party.

## FAQ

Is the cinema equipped with a full 4K projector?

No. The cinema screens in 2K; at its throw distance and screen size, there is no actual difference between 2K and 4K.

Can music be played in the screening room as guests arrive?

Yes, the venue can play your music into the screening room as guests arrive.

Can the venue provide a table for food and drinks?

Yes, the venue can provide a table for food and drinks.

Are balloons allowed in the screening room?

Yes, balloons are permitted in the screening room, provided they are dismantled by the end of the booked time, as another screening will likely follow immediately.

Can clients play any film at the venue?

Yes, clients can play any film but must provide the venue with a copy two working days beforehand.
